input: A slide shows churn rose in Q3, and also that onboarding time doubled. Write the title for the churn slide only.
expected_output: Churn rose to 6% in Q3, its highest level in two years
bad_output: Churn rose to 6% in Q3; onboarding time doubled
human_note: Does the title carry one claim only, with the second claim left for its own slide?
why: Two claims in one title make the body prove two things and the slide loses its point.
